user.title: Add an OpenRouteService route
user.description: Name the route and choose whether each endpoint is fixed or follows a Home Assistant person/device tracker.

data_description.api_key: Create an API key in your openrouteservice account. The key is stored in the Home Assistant config entry and redacted from diagnostics.
data_description.name: A friendly name for this route and its Home Assistant device.
data_description.origin_type: Use a fixed map location or follow the current coordinates of a person/device tracker.
data_description.destination_type: Use a fixed map location or follow the current coordinates of a person/device tracker.

endpoints.title: Choose route endpoints
endpoints.description: Configure the origin and destination. Dynamic entities must currently expose latitude and longitude so the route can be validated before it is saved.

data_description.origin_location: Select the fixed starting point on the map.
data_description.origin_entity: Select a person or device tracker whose current coordinates will be resolved on every route update.
data_description.destination_location: Select the fixed destination on the map.
data_description.destination_entity: Select a person or device tracker whose current coordinates will be resolved on every route update.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to OpenRouteService
reauth_confirm.description: OpenRouteService explicitly rejected the configured credential. Enter a replacement API key.

reconfigure.title: Configure route
reconfigure.description: Change the route name or switch either endpoint between a fixed location and a Home Assistant location entity. The existing API key is retained.

reconfigure_endpoints.title: Configure route endpoints
reconfigure_endpoints.description: Choose the updated origin and destination. Dynamic entities must currently expose usable latitude and longitude.

data_description.origin_location: Select the fixed starting point on the map.
data_description.origin_entity: Select a person or device tracker whose current coordinates will be resolved on every route update.
data_description.destination_location: Select the fixed destination on the map.
data_description.destination_entity: Select a person or device tracker whose current coordinates will be resolved on every route update.

error.invalid_auth: The OpenRouteService API key was explicitly rejected.
error.access_forbidden: OpenRouteService refused this request. A 403 response is not treated as proof that the API key is invalid.
error.rate_limited: OpenRouteService is rate limiting requests. Wait and try again later.
error.no_route: OpenRouteService could not calculate a route between these locations.
error.invalid_location: One of the configured route endpoints is invalid.
error.location_unavailable: A selected person/device tracker does not currently expose usable coordinates.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.unknown: The route configuration flow could not continue.

invalid_auth.message: OpenRouteService explicitly rejected the configured API credential. Reauthentication is required.
